text:
Midday in Burlington and the day is playing out the way the forecasters expected: cloudy and chilly, with temperatures already in the low 40s, about where the afternoon high of 43 will land. The system that brought yesterday's showers has moved off, so any leftover sprinkle should wrap up by 3 and add up to almost nothing. I wouldn't cancel anything over it, but a light jacket is smart, and with the sun setting around 4:25, a walk is best done early.

Tonight stays cloudy and cools to around 32, so a little frost on the windshield is possible in the morning. Monday looks much the same, mostly cloudy with a high near 44. The clouds are stuck under a lid of air that's slow to lift, so don't expect much sun until later in the day.

The better news is Tuesday. A big area of high pressure settles in, and it should feel more like mid-October, with highs near 50 and the 50s sticking around through the week. Tomorrow is a grab-a-jacket day, and the nice stretch starts after that.
